title: A two-cube cubulation of the AIM free-by-cyclic example
strongest_verified_claim: The exact group F(a,b,c) semidirect_phi Z, phi(a)=a, phi(b)=ab, phi(c)=bcb, is the fundamental group of the explicit finite locally CAT(0) general unit cube complex with cell counts (1,7,8,2), dimension three. Its CAT(0) universal cover carries a free proper cocompact cubical action of the full group. The stated target-specific qualitative deduction from earlier WPD, Morse and cubical-completion theorems also meets its hypotheses.
scope_boundaries: Counts are for the face-identification quotient before subdivision; characteristic quotient cubes need not be embedded.
Positive final b and exact marked group are essential; workshop b->aba is a different example.
No minimum dimension/cell count, virtual specialness, historical firstness or absolute novelty conclusion.
AI-assisted review, no external human peer review or proof-assistant certification.
Global geometric consequences rely on checked standard primary theorem imports; finite checks alone are not proofs of them.
Historical AIM question authenticated from archived original; live source timed out and current openness was not established.

independence.incidental_exposure: Manuscript retrospective audit/disclosure statements; helper inline historical labels, PASS/status strings, names and hashes of assessment files; driver numeric baselines after independent reconstruction. No such assessment used as premise.
